    Weighted decomposition of mesh errors (toward Proposition 12.8) #

    deformation-refinements.tex: "In each path degree q ≥ 3, decompose their current mesh errors into the image of the original derivative and the span of the retained p_i of that degree", with the choices made "separately in each degree and weight".

    The retained tuples are rows R_i = (x_i, w_i) whose classes span the cokernels of the mesh derivatives (CokerSpan). Every mesh family of degree m + 1 is D f + Σ_i c_i R_i (exists_span); if it has relative weight γ, then f can be taken of relative weight γ and only the rows of weight γ occur (exists_span_wt), since the weight projections commute with D (wπ_meshDerivative).

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.MeshWalk.mem_span_rows {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type} [Quiver V] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] (c : MeshCoefficients k Q) [Fintype ↑Q.nonprojective] {m : ℕ} (g : ScalarMeshCategory.MeshFamily c) (hg : ∀ (x : ↑Q.nonprojective), g x ∈ ScalarMeshCategory.degreePart c (m + 1) ↑(Q.tau x) ↑x) :
    g ∈ Submodule.span k {e : ScalarMeshCategory.MeshFamily c | ∃ (x : ↑Q.nonprojective) (w : Quiver.Path ↑(Q.tau x) ↑x), w.length = m + 1 ∧ e = ScalarMeshCategory.row c x w}

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.MeshWalk.exists_span {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type} [Quiver V] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] {c : MeshCoefficients k Q} [Fintype ↑Q.nonprojective] {I : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] {Rw : I → (x : ↑Q.nonprojective) × Quiver.Path ↑(Q.tau x) ↑x} (hS : ScalarMeshCategory.CokerSpan c (Set.range Rw)) {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (g : ScalarMeshCategory.MeshFamily c) (hg : ∀ (x : ↑Q.nonprojective), g x ∈ ScalarMeshCategory.degreePart c (m + 1) ↑(Q.tau x) ↑x) :
    ∃ f ∈ ScalarMeshCategory.familiesDeg c m, ∃ (cc : I → k), (∀ (i : I), cc i ≠ 0 → (Rw i).snd.length = m + 1) ∧ g = ScalarMeshCategory.meshDerivative c f + ∑ i : I, cc i • ScalarMeshCategory.row c (Rw i).fst (Rw i).snd

    Mesh errors modulo the image of D are combinations of the retained rows.

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.MeshWalk.wπ_meshDerivative {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type} [Quiver V] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] {c : MeshCoefficients k Q} [Fintype ↑Q.nonprojective] {Wt : Type} [AddCommGroup Wt] (W : MeshWt Q Wt) (hfin : ∀ (x y : V), FiniteDimensional k (ScalarMeshCategory.obj c x ⟶ ScalarMeshCategory.obj c y)) (γ : Wt) (f : ScalarMeshCategory.ArrowFamily c) (x : ↑Q.nonprojective) :
    (wπ c W (W.ν x + γ) ↑(Q.tau x) ↑x) (ScalarMeshCategory.meshDerivative c f x) = ScalarMeshCategory.meshDerivative c (fun (a : (x : V) × (y : V) × (x ⟶ y)) => (wπ c W (W.w a.snd.snd + γ) a.fst a.snd.fst) (f a)) x

    The weight projections commute with the mesh derivative.

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.MeshWalk.exists_span_wt {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type} [Quiver V] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] {c : MeshCoefficients k Q} [Fintype ↑Q.nonprojective] {I : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] {Rw : I → (x : ↑Q.nonprojective) × Quiver.Path ↑(Q.tau x) ↑x} {Wt : Type} [AddCommGroup Wt] (W : MeshWt Q Wt) (hfin : ∀ (x y : V), FiniteDimensional k (ScalarMeshCategory.obj c x ⟶ ScalarMeshCategory.obj c y)) {χ : I → Wt} (hS : ScalarMeshCategory.CokerSpan c (Set.range Rw)) (hwt : ∀ (i : I), W.pw (Rw i).snd = W.ν (Rw i).fst + χ i) {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (γ : Wt) (g : ScalarMeshCategory.MeshFamily c) (hg : ∀ (x : ↑Q.nonprojective), g x ∈ ScalarMeshCategory.degreePart c (m + 1) ↑(Q.tau x) ↑x) (hgw : ∀ (x : ↑Q.nonprojective), g x ∈ wP c W (W.ν x + γ) ↑(Q.tau x) ↑x) :
    ∃ (f : ScalarMeshCategory.ArrowFamily c), (∀ (a : (x : V) × (y : V) × (x ⟶ y)), f a ∈ ScalarMeshCategory.degreePart c m a.fst a.snd.fst ∧ f a ∈ wP c W (W.w a.snd.snd + γ) a.fst a.snd.fst) ∧ ∃ (cc : I → k), (∀ (i : I), cc i ≠ 0 → (Rw i).snd.length = m + 1 ∧ χ i = γ) ∧ g = ScalarMeshCategory.meshDerivative c f + ∑ i : I, cc i • ScalarMeshCategory.row c (Rw i).fst (Rw i).snd
